subject: Pilot extension & alternate top-up options — Clearpath Health
messages:
From: Elliot Summers <elliot@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot extension request + pricing question

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the support during our pilot. The team's been able to validate intent signals on the triage workflow, but our integration timeline slipped because the EMR connector we planned to use needs additional config.

Two asks: can we add 3 more weeks to the current time-boxed evaluation, and would Redwood consider a one-time discount on add-on credits if we top up now? We expect to consume ~60k tokens more than originally forecasted if we extend.

We’re near a decision — this extra time will let our clinical ops run a second round of real-world tests. If helpful I can share the interim metrics and the new runbook.

Appreciate any flexibility.

— Elliot
Elliot Summers
Product Lead, Clearpath Health
elliot@clearpathhealth.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Summers <elliot@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + pricing question

Elliot —

Great to hear the pilot is producing meaningful signals. We can do a couple of options depending on what helps your team move toward conversion faster:

Option A — Timebox extension (preferred for tight timelines)
- 2-week free extension of the current pilot (no additional charge)
- Condition: a short review call and conversion planning session scheduled within the extension window

Option B — Credit top-up (if you want predictable headroom)
- One-time add-on package: $5,000 for 60k additional tokens (effective rate ~ $0.083/token)
- We can offer a 15% one-time discount on that package if you sign the addendum this week

Option C — SKU swap (if concurrency/latency needs shifted)
- Move to a burst-optimized SKU for the remaining pilot run; pricing is usage-based and we can model cost for expected traffic

I’ve looped in our account team to confirm approvals and will attach a short addendum for signature (draft attached). If you prefer, we can structure a hybrid: 1 week free + discounted credit.

What would you prefer? If you want to proceed with Option B discounted top-up I’ll route the DocuSign and get finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Clearpath_Pilot_Addendum_v2.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension request + pricing question — approval needed

Team — forwarding Clearpath’s ask (see below). They want +3 weeks or a discounted top-up. Recommend we present a two-path offer: 2-week free extension + 15% on 60k token top-up OR a 3-week extension for $5k. Rationale: keeps runway but preserves unit economics.

Ask:
- Can finance approve 15% off one-time top-up if signed this week?
- Legal: quick addendum (attached) — any material redlines?
- CS (Monica): add conversion planning session requirement into the addendum and capture success criteria.

I’ll wait for flags; want to respond to Clearpath by EOD Friday.

— Michael

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension request + pricing question — approval needed

Michael / team —

I’m OK with a constrained concession structure:
- Offer a 2-week complimentary extension (not 3 weeks) to keep momentum without a revenue hit.
- Offer a one-time 15% discount on a 60k-token top-up if they sign the addendum within 7 days.
- Add conversion planning session + clear success metrics (2 KPIs) as a condition; if those are met, we’ll auto-apply a $2k conversion credit toward first month if they convert to a paid plan.

Legal: I’ll review the addendum and propose a small wording change around termination / usage caps. Finance (Aditya) — please confirm the 15% on a $5k package is acceptable.

— Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Summers <elliot@clearpathhealth.com>, procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request + pricing question

Elliot —

Thanks for the patience. After internal review we can move forward with a compact, two-path proposal so you can pick what’s operationally easiest:

Path 1 (time-focused):
- 2-week complimentary extension to the current pilot (no charge).
- Condition: schedule a 45-minute conversion planning session with our CS and Product teams during the extension period.
- If you convert to a paid plan within 30 days of the pilot end, we’ll apply a $2,000 conversion credit to month one.

Path 2 (credit-focused):
- 3-week extension bundled with a 60k token top-up for $5,000 (pre-discount).
- If you sign the addendum this week we’ll apply a one-time 15% discount (final top-up price $4,250).

Next steps: I attached the short addendum (Clearpath_Pilot_Addendum_v2.pdf) and created the DocuSign link for the top-up path. Please tell me which path you prefer and I’ll get the DocuSign routed.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/clearpath-addendum/rdw-4321
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/contacts/clearpath/4321
